message.content:
With three fair coins tossed, the number of heads you can obtain ranges from 0 to 3.  
Here’s the full probability distribution:

| Heads | Probability |
|-------|-------------|
| 0     | 1/8 (12.5 %) |
| 1     | 3/8 (37.5 %) |
| 2     | 3/8 (37.5 %) |
| 3     | 1/8 (12.5 %) |

So you can get 0, 1, 2, or 3 heads, with the probabilities shown above.
